metadata.description:
Jou Bidwi — the traditional rice beer of the Bodo community — is more than just a drink; it’s a symbol of culture, togetherness, and tradition. Prepared naturally without any chemicals, its unique taste comes from a careful fermentation process passed down through generations.

In this episode, Main Bhi Bharat editor Shyam Sunder travels to Kokrajhar, Assam, to learn how Bodo women make this special rice beer at home. Watch how tradition, taste, and community spirit come together in every drop of Jou Bidwi!

Subscribe to Main Bhi Bharat for more stories celebrating India’s tribal heritage.
